text:
Ellie: Heads up — SkyBridge procurement rejected our PO during marketplace ingestion. They say the billing entity on the PO doesn't match the certified hardware vendor name, so intake is blocked. Any quick path forward?
Sam: @Ellie can you paste the PO XML they returned (or a screenshot)? need to see the exact mismatch.
Ellie: Pasted the minimal snippet they flagged:
```xml
<PurchaseOrder id="12345">
  <buyerName>SkyBridge Ltd</buyerName>
  <sellerName>SkyBridge HW Reseller</sellerName>
  <billingEntity>Redwood Inference LLC</billingEntity> <!-- they expected SkyBridge HW Reseller -->
</PurchaseOrder>
```
Sam: Ok — their portal validates that sellerName==billingEntity for marketplace compliance. Legal can do a redline but procurement often wants vendor certification attached.
Maria: From finance: we can't just flip the billing entity on our invoices without an addendum. Changing it now will break GL mapping and tax docs unless there's an attestation. How fast do they need this?
Kevin: Customer is pushing for tomorrow's launch in APAC, so fast. Is there a one-page workaround (billing attestation) we can use while legal finalizes redlines?
Sam: I can draft a one-page billing attestation. It'll state that SkyBridge HW Reseller acts as authorized reseller and Redwood will accept invoices to Redwood Inc for this transaction, with indemnity clause. Minimal ask from their legal.
Daria (procurement-bot): Automated: PO 12345 rejected — reason: vendor_cert_mismatch. Ticket created: https://redwood.ai/ops/tickets/PROC-7891
Ellie: @Sam please keep the attestation minimal. Also, is there an option for SkyBridge to reissue the PO with billingEntity=SkyBridge HW Reseller instead? That seems cleaner if they can do it quickly.
Maria: Finance can accept a corrected PO from SkyBridge and route invoices to our AR as normal, but it requires updated ledger mapping. I can standby and do the mapping once we have the final billing entity. ETA: ~1 business day to update AR rules.
Kevin: I'll ask the SkyBridge PM if they can reissue the PO today. If not, we'll try the attestation path.
Sam: Draft attestation snippet (will formalize):
"By signing below, Redwood Inference acknowledges that SkyBridge HW Reseller is the authorized vendor for Purchase Order 12345. Redwood will accept invoices referencing Redwood Inference LLC and release payment to SkyBridge HW Reseller on completion of delivery. This attestation does not modify the underlying reseller agreement."
Ellie: Thanks. @Maria — can finance accept the attestation as a temporary bridge while legal finalizes the vendor addendum?
Maria: Yes, contingent on invoice footnotes and tagging in the ledger. I'll prepare the GL mapping steps and email AR with the ticket number.
Ellie: Great — @Kevin please send the reissue request to SkyBridge PM; if they can't, I'll send Sam's attestation for signature. I'll also escalate ingestion so marketplace doesn't auto-fail the job.
Kevin: Sent to PM. Will update in 30m. :thumbsup:
Daria (procurement-bot): Ticket PRO C-7891 status updated -> awaiting_customer_response.
Ellie: Closing loop here — thanks everyone. I'll post updates in this thread as they come in.
